query:
SELECT 
  pc.id,
  p1.name as parent_product,
  p2.name as child_product,
  pc.quantity,
  pc.createdAt
FROM productCompositions pc
JOIN products p1 ON pc.parentProductId = p1.id
JOIN products p2 ON pc.childProductId = p2.id
WHERE p1.name LIKE '%Dose%'
ORDER BY p1.name, pc.id
